text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $64.7K with minimal movement, while Ethereum is outpacing it with a 2.2% daily gain, suggesting some rotation toward altcoins despite dominant coins holding ground. The Fear & Greed index remains in fear territory at 26 and has actually declined over the past week, indicating persistent market caution even as prices stabilize. BTC dominance remains elevated at 56.4% with moderate volume, pointing to a consolidation phase where investors are defensive but not capitulating.
